verses.en: Set aside every other path and come to me alone for shelter. I will release you from every wrong. Don't be afraid.
verses.hi: सारे धर्मों को छोड़कर केवल मेरी शरण में आ जाओ। मैं तुम्हें सब पापों से मुक्त कर दूँगा। चिंता मत करो।
verses.short: Drop the pressure and overthinking. Trust me completely and I've got you. Don't stress.
verses.notes: What is Krishna's final teaching? Let go of every other support and take refuge in him alone. What does he promise? He will free you from all wrongs. Do not grieve.

verses.en: Never share this with someone who lacks discipline, who has no devotion, who doesn't want to listen, or who speaks ill of me.
verses.hi: यह बात कभी उसे मत बताना जिसमें तप नहीं, भक्ति नहीं, जो सुनना नहीं चाहता, या जो मेरी निंदा करता है।
verses.short: Don't force this on people who aren't interested, aren't disciplined, or mock it.
verses.notes: Who shouldn't be told this teaching? Those without discipline or devotion, who don't want to listen, or who mock the Divine. Why? It won't help them, and they may misuse it.

verses.en: Whoever shares this supreme secret with my devotees, showing the highest devotion to me, will surely come to me.
verses.hi: जो मेरी परम भक्ति करते हुए यह परम रहस्य मेरे भक्तों को बताएगा, वह निश्चय ही मुझे पाएगा।
verses.short: Whoever shares this wisdom with sincere seekers will surely come to me.
verses.notes: What happens to one who shares this with devotees? They gain supreme devotion and come to Krishna. Why is sharing so valued? It helps others find peace.

verses.en: No one among people does me a dearer service than they do, and no one on earth will ever be dearer to me.
verses.hi: इंसानों में उससे बढ़कर मेरा प्रिय काम करने वाला कोई नहीं, और धरती पर उससे ज़्यादा मुझे प्रिय कोई और नहीं होगा।
verses.short: No one does anything dearer to me than that. Nobody will be dearer to me.
verses.notes: How dear is such a person to Krishna? No one does him dearer service, and no one will be dearer. What does this tell us? Spreading wisdom is the highest service.

verses.en: And whoever studies this sacred conversation of ours, I consider them to be worshipping me through the offering of knowledge.
verses.hi: और जो हमारे इस धर्ममय संवाद का अध्ययन करेगा, मेरे मत में वह ज्ञान-यज्ञ से मेरी पूजा करेगा।
verses.short: Even studying this conversation counts as worshipping me through knowledge.
verses.notes: What about those who study this dialogue? Krishna says they worship him through the sacrifice of knowledge. So reading the Gita is worship? Yes, when done sincerely.

verses.en: Even someone who just listens with faith and without finding fault will be freed and reach the happy worlds of those who do good.
verses.hi: जो इंसान श्रद्धा से और बिना दोष निकाले केवल इसे सुनेगा, वह भी मुक्त होकर पुण्य करने वालों के शुभ लोकों को पाएगा।
verses.short: And just listening with faith, without picking holes, sets you free too.
verses.notes: What about those who just listen? Even listening with faith and without fault-finding brings freedom and good worlds. Why include listeners? Everyone can benefit, even without deep study.

verses.en: Arjuna, have you heard this with full attention? Has your confusion born of ignorance been destroyed?
verses.hi: हे पार्थ, क्या तुमने इसे एकाग्र मन से सुना? हे धनंजय, क्या अज्ञान से पैदा हुआ तुम्हारा मोह मिट गया?
verses.short: "Arjuna, did you really listen? Is your confusion gone?" The ultimate check-in.
verses.notes: What does Krishna ask at the end? 'Did you listen carefully? Is your confusion gone?' What does this show about him as a teacher? He checks that the student understood.

verses.en: Arjuna said: My confusion is gone, Krishna. By your grace I have remembered who I am. I stand firm, free from doubt. I will do as you say.
verses.hi: अर्जुन ने कहा: हे अच्युत, आपकी कृपा से मेरा मोह मिट गया और मुझे अपनी पहचान याद आ गई। मैं संदेह से मुक्त होकर दृढ़ खड़ा हूँ। मैं आपकी बात मानूँगा।
verses.short: Arjuna: "My confusion is gone. I remember who I am. No doubts left. I'll do what you say." Glow-up complete.
verses.notes: How does Arjuna answer? 'My confusion is gone, I've regained clarity by your grace. I'll do as you say.' What has changed since Chapter 1? From despair and doubt to clarity and resolve.

verses.en: Sanjaya said: So I heard this wonderful conversation between Krishna and the great-souled Arjuna, which makes my hair stand on end.
verses.hi: संजय ने कहा: इस तरह मैंने वासुदेव और महात्मा अर्जुन का यह अद्भुत संवाद सुना, जिससे रोंगटे खड़े हो जाते हैं।
verses.short: Sanjaya: "I heard this amazing conversation between Krishna and Arjuna. Goosebumps."
verses.notes: How does Sanjaya feel? Thrilled; the wondrous dialogue makes his hair stand on end. Why include his reaction? It shows the dialogue's power on anyone who hears it.

verses.en: By the grace of Vyasa, I heard this supreme secret yoga directly from Krishna, the lord of yoga, as he himself spoke it.
verses.hi: व्यासजी की कृपा से मैंने यह परम गुप्त योग सीधे योगेश्वर श्रीकृष्ण से, उन्हीं के मुख से कहते हुए सुना।
verses.short: "Thanks to Vyasa, I heard this highest wisdom straight from Krishna himself."
verses.notes: How could Sanjaya hear all this? By the grace of Vyasa, who gave him divine sight. Who did he hear it from? Directly from Krishna, the Lord of Yoga.

verses.en: O King, as I recall again and again this wonderful and holy conversation between Krishna and Arjuna, I rejoice again and again.
verses.hi: हे राजन, श्रीकृष्ण और अर्जुन के इस अद्भुत और पवित्र संवाद को बार-बार याद करके मैं बार-बार आनंदित होता हूँ।
verses.short: "Every time I remember this conversation, I feel joy all over again."
verses.notes: What does Sanjaya keep doing? Remembering the dialogue again and again, and rejoicing each time. What does this show? The Gita rewards repeated reflection.

verses.en: And as I recall again and again that most wonderful form of Krishna, my amazement is great, O King, and I rejoice again and again.
verses.hi: और हे राजन, श्रीहरि के उस अत्यंत अद्भुत रूप को बार-बार याद करके मुझे बड़ा आश्चर्य होता है और मैं बार-बार आनंदित होता हूँ।
verses.short: "And remembering that cosmic form of Krishna, I'm amazed again and again."
verses.notes: What else does Sanjaya remember? Krishna's wondrous cosmic form. How does it affect him? He is amazed and rejoices again and again.

verses.en: Wherever there is Krishna, the lord of yoga, and wherever there is Arjuna, the archer, there will surely be fortune, victory, prosperity and right conduct. That is my belief.
verses.hi: जहाँ योगेश्वर श्रीकृष्ण हैं और जहाँ धनुर्धर अर्जुन हैं, वहीं श्री, विजय, समृद्धि और अटल नीति है। यही मेरा मत है।
verses.short: Wherever Krishna's wisdom and Arjuna's action meet, there's success, prosperity and doing what's right. Final word.
verses.notes: How does the Gita end? Where Krishna and Arjuna are, there is fortune, victory, prosperity and righteousness. What does it mean for us? When wisdom (Krishna) and effort (Arjuna) come together, good things follow.
